title: SpotServe: Serving Generative Large Language Models on Preemptible Instances
technique: dynamic reparallelization under spot preemptions, bipartite-matching (Kuhn-Munkres) instance migration, stateful token-level inference recovery during grace period

optimized_metrics.evidence: This paper aims to reduce the monetary cost for serving LLMs by leveraging preemptible GPU instances
SpotServe can reduce the P99 tail latency by 2.4 - 9.1x compared with the best existing LLM serving systems.
the optimizer minimizes the end-to-end inference latency l_req(C) while maintaining a throughput higher than alpha_t
minimizes the end-to-end inference latency l_req(C) while maintaining a throughput higher than alpha_t (request arrival rate); otherwise maximizes the overall serving throughput
other targets are also feasible, such as meeting the requirements of pre-defined SLO (i.e., l_req(C) <= l_SLO)

headline_claim.text: reduce the P99 tail latency by 2.4-9.1x compared with the best existing LLM serving systems ... saving 54% monetary cost compared with only using on-demand instances

metric_definitions.definition_quote: minimizes the end-to-end inference latency l_req(C)
metric_definitions.notes: request latency including queueing, interruption and migration overhead; no formal TTFT/TPOT used

metric_definitions.definition_quote: Figure 7 presents the per-token costs of all baseline systems ... on-demand instance ... 3.9 USD/h v.s. 1.9 USD/h
metric_definitions.notes: price per token from instance hours

slo_spec: optional l_SLO bound in optimizer; no attainment-based evaluation
load_regime: trace replay of real AWS spot availability (two 20-min segments) with Gamma arrivals (CV 6) at fixed rates per model, plus MAF production trace for dynamic workloads
tradeoff_acknowledged: throughput, latency and monetary cost trade-off; on-demand cheaper-latency trade (lower cost raises latency)
workloads: Gamma arrivals with CV 6, MAF trace
extractor_notes: Primary measurable objective is P99 request latency under preemption; cost is the stated motivation. Models OPT-6.7B, GPT-20B, LLaMA-30B (parameter table ~line 580).
